SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm_orders__customer_id_count_distinct_window_90d AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.order_date",
    COUNT(DISTINCT _src._w_value) AS "orders.customers_90d"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date"
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      (
        orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND orders.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
      )
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _base
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      orders.order_date AS _w_time,
      orders.customer_id AS _w_value
    FROM orders AS orders
  ) AS _src
    ON _src._w_time >= CAST(CAST(_base."orders.order_date" + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - INTERVAL 90 DAY AS DATE)
    AND _src._w_time < CAST(_base."orders.order_date" + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders.order_date"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.order_date",
  COALESCE(_cm_orders__customer_id_count_distinct_window_90d."orders.customers_90d", 0) AS "orders.customers_90d"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customer_id_count_distinct_window_90d
  ON _base."orders.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customer_id_count_distinct_window_90d."orders.order_date"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: For each month of 2025, this counts the distinct customers who placed at least one order in the 90 days up to and including the month's last day. Orders of every status are included, both "ok" and "bad". The 90-day window can reach back into late 2024. Counts range from 154 (May and June) to 162 (February and October).
